**Debug log (helps a lot with bugs that are hard to repeat)**
Turn on Settings › Advanced › Debug log, tap Save & Apply, make the bug happen again, then tap Share log and attach the
file here. Server addresses, names and messages are taken out of it; you can read it through before attaching it.
